description: Figure 8 illustrates the relative change across different layer groups for various quantization configurations on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents layer groups categorically, with tick labels for "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at 10% intervals (-25%, -15%, -5%, and 5%). A grey dashed line with no markers represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit," which remains constant at 0% across all layer groups. The solid yellow line with circle markers, representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips to approximately -3% at Layer13-20, and returns to near 0% by Layer29-32. The solid red line with square markers, representing "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," remains relatively steady near 0% from Layer1-4 through Layer29-32. The solid light blue line with circle markers, representing "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," begins near -2% at Layer1-4, declines to a minimum of approximately -13% at Layer13-20, and rises to end near -1% at Layer29-32. The solid dark blue line with square markers, representing "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," starts near -3% at Layer1-4, experiences a sharp decline to a minimum of approximately -24% at Layer13-20, and recovers to end near -2% at Layer29-32.
